title: Honeynet analyst session view — possible_success attack session
event_type: Honeynet correlation platform, attack_sessions record rendered as an analyst-facing session view, status possible_success

callouts.explanation: possible_success is the platform's own status field showing the session progressed past a bare exploit attempt to continued post-attempt activity from the same source.
Each transition (recon -> probe -> exploit_attempt -> possible_success) is a separate correlation decision joining events on the same source-to-target pairing within a bounded window, per Part 30.
The technique set accumulates across the session rather than resetting per event, showing the full breadth of observed behavior (T1595, T1046, T1083, T1190) an analyst would triage at once.

note: Illustrative/conceptual rendering of what an analyst-facing session view would show for this real correlated session; not a captured screenshot of the honeynet platform's actual UI or any other product interface.
